create_async_executor: create an AsyncExecutor instance that runs a blocking function asynchronously on a background thread
put_element_async: put an element onto the AsyncExecutor data queue to be processed asynchronously by the background thread
close_async_executor: close the AsyncExecutor by stopping the background thread and joining it before raising any errors
raise_on_error_async: raise any error that occurred in the AsyncExecutor background thread onto the caller thread
review_async_executor_class: review the AsyncExecutor class and its thread-safe queue-based async execution pattern for blocking functions
